description: Java class HttpClient for sending HTTP GET/POST requests, handling connections, headers, authentication, and response processing within the org.apache.ofbiz.base.util package.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A utility class for executing HTTP GET and POST requests with support for headers, parameters, authentication, SSL, and response handling.

methods.name: HttpClient
methods.description: Constructors for creating HttpClient instances with various initial configurations.

methods.name: setDebug
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging for this instance.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the connection timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: followRedirects
methods.description: Enables or disables following HTTP redirects.

methods.name: setLineFeed
methods.description: Enables or disables line feeds in response content.

methods.name: setRawStream
methods.description: Sets raw stream data for POST requests.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the request URL.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Sets request parameters.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Adds a single request parameter.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets request headers.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Adds a single request header.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns request headers.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns request parameters.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the request URL.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the Content-Type header.

methods.name: setStreamCharset
methods.description: Sets the charset for stream encoding.

methods.name: getStreamCharset
methods.description: Returns the stream charset.

methods.name: setKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables or disables keep-alive for the connection.

methods.name: getKeepAlive
methods.description: Returns the keep-alive setting.

methods.name: setClientCertificateAlias
methods.description: Sets the SSL client certificate alias.

methods.name: getClientCertificateAlias
methods.description: Returns the SSL client certificate alias.

methods.name: setHostVerificationLevel
methods.description: Sets the hostname verification level for SSL.

methods.name: getHostVerificationLevel
methods.description: Returns the hostname verification level.

methods.name: setAllowUntrusted
methods.description: Allows untrusted server certificates.

methods.name: getAllowUntrusted
methods.description: Returns whether untrusted certificates are allowed.

methods.name: setBasicAuthInfo
methods.description: Sets basic authentication credentials.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns response as String.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns response as InputStream.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request and returns response as String.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with raw stream data.

methods.name: postStream
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request and returns response as InputStream.

methods.description: Retrieves a specific response header value.

methods.description: Retrieves the value of a response header field by index.

methods.name: getResponseContent
methods.description: Returns the response content object.

methods.name: getResponseContentType
methods.description: Returns the response content type.

methods.name: getResponseContentLength
methods.description: Returns the response content length.

methods.name: getResponseContentEncoding
methods.description: Returns the response content encoding.

methods.name: getResponseCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response code.

methods.description: Internal method to send HTTP request and get response as String.
